result:
T-DG6-BE-Z5 is done, all three items including the separable item 2, and the required checks pass on the final tree. The changes are uncommitted for you to integrate. There are no migrations, no new dependencies and no OpenAPI changes.

**F-DG6-300, a sensitive benefit leaking through derived views.** A reader who gets 404 on the benefit no longer sees it here:
- **Traceability graph:** the benefit's node and every edge touching it are left out. The other nodes' orphan flags still count all edges, so the graph stays truthful.
- **Trace links:** links into the benefit are left out of the list, and the benefit's allocation set answers 404. I added `trace_link` and `traceLinkId` to the sensitive-reach maps, as the ADR amendment requires for a table that carries a benefit's values.
- **Missing links:** the benefit's warning is left out, with no count. The "no benefit" check still counts every benefit, so it never claims there are none.
- **G6 readiness:** the item stays, because it must still block submission. Its text is the same for every reader and names no code, title or id ("a restricted benefit has no Finance-validated measurement…"), because that text is frozen into submissions and refusals.
- **Reports:** one new per-reader function, `reporting/reports/restricted.ts`, covers live reports, stored snapshots and their sub-lists for every report type. Restricted rows are removed at read time, so a snapshot generated by an admitted user shows them only to admitted readers. Export of such a snapshot stays refused.
- **Change-impact preview:** the benefit's item is left out and counted in the existing `hiddenItemCount` field. Frozen impact assessments leave the item out at read time.

**F-DG6-280, the escalation copying the title (item 2):**
- **Corrective case:** when the benefit is marked sensitive, the worker titles its case with the case's own code (`CA-nn`) instead of the benefit's title.
- **Executive ask:** an ask raised from any benefit's corrective case is always titled by the case code. A benefit can be marked after its ask exists, and ask titles are never rewritten.
- **Blocker status on a case the caller can't read:** I refused it, with the same 422 `blocker_status.record_not_found` as an unknown id rather than a 404. In that route 404 means "meeting not found", so a different answer would reveal the case exists. Linking an executive ask to such a case is refused the same way, and the blocker-status list leaves those statuses out.

**Sweep (item 3).** `sensitive-reach-sweep.test.ts` runs on the seeded demo data, with the real worker creating a corrective case, red review cycles, an ask and its notification. It covers 375 of the 446 GET operations (418 requests per reader), plus live register reports, admitted-user snapshots, search and the inbox. Not-admitted TL and AUD readers never get the title, the code-with-title or the planned value `7654321.1234`. An admitted TL still does, as the positive control. The other 71 operations can't be filled from the demo data, and the test logs them by name.

I ported the reviewers' probes into three more tests (`sensitive-reach-derived`, `-escalation`, `-impact`). With the source fix reverse-applied, the four new files fail as intended: 6 failed, 3 passed, 5 skipped.

**Checks (logs in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-BE-Z5-evidence/`):**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG5` | PASS, exit 0 |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm openapi:lint` | exit 0 |
| prettier check | exit 0. The first run exited 123 on two of my unformatted files; I formatted them. |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset | exit 0: 2899 + 2039 + 259 passed, 2 skipped. The first run exited 1: the module-boundary test rejected an array-index lookup in my new file, which I rewrote. |
| `pnpm test`, C.UTF-8 | exit 0, same counts |
| Touched integration suites (64 files, all the areas the assignment lists) | exit 0: 566 passed, 1 skipped. The skip is an existing conditional skip in `presentation.test.ts`. |
| Final rerun: the 4 new files plus key suites (10 files) | exit 0, 63 passed |

The 64-file run happened before two last edits: the rewrite of that array lookup and a formatting pass. The 10-file rerun and all static and unit checks ran afterwards; the other 54 files did not.

**What remains (all in the handback):**
- **Optional decision for the architect:** report documents have no `includesRestrictedRecords` field, so a report total that includes an omitted row isn't labelled "Includes restricted records" the way dashboard totals are. Adding it is an additive change to the stored-report schema.
- **Old data:** an ask or case created before this fix keeps the benefit's title in its stored row; nothing rewrites it. Whether that needs a data migration is your call.
- **Not covered:** the search index is empty in the sweep because the worker's indexer doesn't run there.
- **Still visible:** frozen G6 snapshots still list benefit ids. Action-register rows still show the case code, which is now also the ask's title.

The full write-up is `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-BE-Z5-backend-workflow-engineer.md`.
